title: GPU thermal throttling
description: GPU reaches 87 C, core clock falls 2610 to 1830 MHz, and the vendor reports a hardware thermal slowdown.

events.title: GPU thermal throttling
events.whatHappened: Frame time rose to 52 ms while the GPU ran at 87 C.
events.mechanism: The GPU reached its temperature limit and reduced clock speed to stay within it. Less clock means less work per second, so frames take longer.
events.recommendedAction: Improve case airflow or clean the GPU cooler. Lowering the power limit slightly often costs little performance and drops temperature substantially.

evidence.statement: The GPU reported a thermal limit as the reason for reducing clocks
GPU core clock fell 2204 MHz to 1995 MHz

ruledOut.title: Background CPU contention
ruledOut.reason: Total CPU load did not rise materially (peak 42%).

ruledOut.title: CPU frequency collapse
ruledOut.reason: CPU effective clock stayed near 4.59 GHz.

ruledOut.title: GPU power limit
ruledOut.reason: The GPU reported a thermal limit as the reason for its clocks.

ruledOut.title: Storage stall
ruledOut.reason: Disk response time stayed at 0.5 ms.

ruledOut.title: Driver interrupt latency
ruledOut.reason: Kernel-mode time stayed at 0.7% (deferred calls and interrupts).
